scientific_integrity: Claims are formulated as theorems with a self-contained proof. The standalone verifier exhaustively checks declared finite cases; its finite checks are not presented as an infinite proof. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The explicit binomial enumerators require uniform replacement cliques of size \(s\ge2\) and a path/cycle base (extended multiplicatively to maximum-degree-two bases). The general reduction is valid for arbitrary base graphs but does not give closed forms there; nonuniform cliques are not covered by the formulas. The proof has not undergone independent review. Neither finite checks nor the searches certify bibliographic priority.
title: Exact locally-optimal colouring polynomials of clique-blown-up paths and cycles
